title.narrative: 23M-A2I - Green Hub Kampala (GHK) - E-mobility ecosystem for climate change mitigation and improved livelihoods in Uganda

description.narrative: The longer-term development contribution of the project is five-fold: 1) Increased income for boda drivers and livelihood opportunities for women and youth in the e-mobility sector. 2) Reduction of air pollution, leading to improved health for citizens as well as improved working conditions for drivers due to the increased safety and security conditions of the e-boda. 3) Sustainable waste management by recycling the old bodas. 4) Introducing e-bodas running on green energy is the first step in the transition to a green transport sector in Uganda and the first 60 e-bodas will lead to an annual reduction of 124 tons CO2. 5) The MP will unite partnerships across different sectors and across government, private sector and civil society, to together tackle Uganda's transport and energy challenges and to fight climate change, which aligns with the national development agenda of Uganda.
